jobDescription: A consumer lender collects arrears on personal loans and credit cards through an in-house team. The collections operations manager line-manages the agents, applies the forbearance policy within delegated limits, runs call-quality assurance and reports arrears and team metrics to the head of operations. The lender is replacing its collections system next year and would value someone who has run a collections or dialler system migration from start to switch-over. The team of about a dozen agents works two shifts, and the manager works closely with the credit risk team on forbearance referrals.
requirements: Line-manages a team of collections agents, including rotas, one-to-ones and performance reviews.
Applies the forbearance policy within delegated limits and refers cases beyond them.
Runs call-quality assurance and feeds the results into coaching.
Reports arrears and team metrics to the head of operations.
Has run a collections-system or dialler migration.

evidence.text: Collections team manager at Northgate Lending from April 2019 to September 2024, line manager of eleven collections agents with responsibility for rotas, monthly one-to-ones and annual performance reviews.
Approved forbearance arrangements within the team's delegated limit (payment plans of up to twelve months) and referred longer arrangements to the credit risk team.
Scored five calls per agent each month against the call-quality framework and used the scores in the monthly one-to-ones, agreeing a coaching point with each agent.
Sent the weekly arrears and team-metrics report to the head of operations: accounts worked, promises to pay and payment plans agreed, broken down by shift.

Represented the collections team on the 2023 dialler replacement, testing call scripts and agent screens before the switch-over and briefing the agents on the new screens; the IT change team ran the project.
Work sample: the team's 2023 organisation chart and an anonymised annual performance review for one agent, naming the candidate as reviewing manager and the head of operations as countersigner.
HR verification note: the title Collections Team Manager and the employment period (April 2019 to September 2024) were confirmed in writing by Northgate Lending's HR department.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate would like to discuss the weekend cover arrangements before the final interview and can start after a one-month notice period.
